# hi-api-contract-discovery: hướng dẫn

<!-- generated by scripts/gen-wiki-pages.mjs from SKILL.md; edit the skill, then re-run -->

> Sinh draft hợp đồng API HTTP và bất đồng bộ (OpenAPI/AsyncAPI): endpoint, message, schema, auth, lỗi, consumer/provider — chỉ là draft có bằng chứng.

**Mô tả gốc (EN):** Produce draft-only evidence-backed HTTP and asynchronous API contracts, including OpenAPI or AsyncAPI drafts, endpoints, messages, schemas, authentication, authorization, errors, consumers, and providers. Do not deploy APIs, modify implementations, or publish inferred contracts as authoritative.
